fullText.simplified:
十四、真假药水

    第二天，许仙告诉城里的病人，他也有药水，不要钱。大家听了，都去他那儿喝药。游医知道了，说：“不可能，只有我有药！别人的药都是假的！”
    很多人还是相信游医，他们借钱买了游医的药，但喝了药，病却没有好。有些人没有钱，只能去许仙那儿。这些人喝了许仙的药，病却好了。
    游医听说了，一边说“不可能”，一边来到了许仙的药店。他看着许仙拿着瓶子给病人倒药水，不敢相信地说：“那是……那是……”他拿出自己的瓶子，看了又看，然后明白了。他生气极了，想要冲过去打许仙。
    这时候，几个病人跑过来，拉着他说：“喝了你的药，病也没有好！你！把钱还给我！”旁边的人听到了，也拉着他说：“许医生的药不要钱，你的药为什么那么贵？快把钱还给我！”
    更多的人跑过来，叫着让游医还钱。人越来越多，他们在游医身上找，把他身上的钱全拿走了。游医被人拉着，一点儿办法也没有。很快，他身上一分钱都没有了。
    游医生气极了。他看着药店里的许仙，想要动手去打他。一道白色的闪电劈下来，把游医劈飞了。
    游医掉落到了一片树林里，真疼！他叫着爬起来，看到了一个穿青衣的姑娘。
    他吃惊地问：“你是谁？”
    青衣姑娘问：“城里的人为什么生病？”
    他更吃惊地问：“你是谁？”
    “不回答？那我就动手了。”青衣姑娘跳过来就打他。
    游医打不过青衣姑娘，很快就被打回了原形，一只黑羊。
    “姑娘，不要打了！我说！”黑羊说，“我在城中的河里放了不好的东西，喝过河水的人都会生病。”
    “你那个瓶子是哪儿来的？”
    “我在一个山里捡的。”
    “哪里的山？”
    “南海。”
    “你能变成人形，是在哪儿修炼的？”
    “南海。”
    青衣姑娘满意地点点头，说：“你走吧，别让我和姐姐再看见你！”
    黑羊爬起来，飞快地跑了。
    七天之后，城里生病的人都好了。白素贞和许仙还在城中的河里倒了药瓶中的药水，现在河水变干净了。大家很感谢许仙和白素贞，都说他们真是世界上最好的医生。每个人都很相信他们，那种感觉真是好极了。小青跟着他们，也觉得人间的生活真是越来越有趣了。

十四、真假藥水

    第二天，許仙告訴城裡的病人，他也有藥水，不要錢。大家聽了，都去他那兒喝藥。遊醫知道了，說：“不可能，只有我有藥！別人的藥都是假的！”
    很多人還是相信遊醫，他們借錢買了遊醫的藥，但喝了藥，病卻沒有好。有些人沒有錢，只能去許仙那兒。這些人喝了許仙的藥，病卻好了。
    遊醫聽說了，一邊說“不可能”，一邊來到了許仙的藥店。他看著許仙拿著瓶子給病人倒藥水，不敢相信地說：“那是……那是……”他拿出自己的瓶子，看了又看，然後明白了。他生氣極了，想要衝過去打許仙。
    這時候，幾個病人跑過來，拉著他說：“喝了你的藥，病也沒有好！你！把錢還給我！”旁邊的人聽到了，也拉著他說：“許醫生的藥不要錢，你的藥為什麼那麼貴？快把錢還給我！”
    更多的人跑過來，叫著讓遊醫還錢。人越來越多，他們在遊醫身上找，把他身上的錢全拿走了。遊醫被人拉著，一點兒辦法也沒有。很快，他身上一分錢都沒有了。
    遊醫生氣極了。他看著藥店裡的許仙，想要動手去打他。一道白色的閃電劈下來，把遊醫劈飛了。
    遊醫掉落到了一片樹林裡，真疼！他叫著爬起來，看到了一個穿青衣的姑娘。
    他吃驚地問：“你是誰？”
    青衣姑娘問：“城裡的人為什麼生病？”
    他更吃驚地問：“你是誰？”
    “不回答？那我就動手了。”青衣姑娘跳過來就打他。
    遊醫打不過青衣姑娘，很快就被打回了原形，一隻黑羊。
    “姑娘，不要打了！我說！”黑羊說，“我在城中的河裡放了不好的東西，喝過河水的人都會生病。”
    “你那個瓶子是哪兒來的？”
    “我在一個山裡撿的。”
    “哪裡的山？”
    “南海。”
    “你能變成人形，是在哪兒修煉的？”
    “南海。”
    青衣姑娘滿意地點點頭，說：“你走吧，別讓我和姐姐再看見你！”
    黑羊爬起來，飛快地跑了。
    七天之後，城裡生病的人都好了。白素貞和許仙還在城中的河裡倒了藥瓶中的藥水，現在河水變乾淨了。大家很感謝許仙和白素貞，都說他們真是世界上最好的醫生。每個人都很相信他們，那種感覺真是好極了。小青跟著他們，也覺得人間的生活真是越來越有趣了。

sentences.pinyin: dà jiā hěn gǎn xiè xǔ xiān hé bái sù zhēn dōu shuō tā men zhēn shì shì jiè shang zuì hǎo de yī shēng
sentences.english: Everyone was very grateful to Xu Xian and Bai Suzhen, saying that they truly were the best doctors in the world.

sentences.simplified: 每个人都很相信他们，那种感觉真是好极了。
sentences.traditional: 每個人都很相信他們，那種感覺真是好極了。
sentences.pinyin: měi ge rén dōu hěn xiāng xìn tā men nà zhǒng gǎn jué zhēn shi hǎo jí le
sentences.english: Everyone really trusted them, and that feeling was truly wonderful.

sentences.simplified: 小青跟着他们，也觉得人间的生活真是越来越有趣了。
sentences.traditional: 小青跟著他們，也覺得人間的生活真是越來越有趣了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo qīng gēn zhe tā men yě jué de rén jiān de shēng huó zhēn shi yuè lái yuè yǒu qù le
sentences.english: Xiaoqing followed them and also felt that life in the human world was becoming more and more interesting.

sentence_translations: 14. Real and Fake Medicine
The next day, Xu Xian told the patients in the city that he also had medicine and it didn’t cost anything.
Everyone heard about this, and went to him to drink the medicine.
The traveling doctor learned of this and said, “Impossible, only I have the medicine! Other people’s medicine is fake!”
Many people still trusted the traveling doctor. They borrowed money and bought the traveling doctor’s medicine.
But after taking the medicine, their illness did not go away.
Some people had no money, and could only go to Xu Xian. These people took Xu Xian’s medicine, and their illness was cured.
The traveling doctor heard about this, saying “impossible” while heading over to Xu Xian’s pharmacy.
He watched Xu Xian hold the bottle and pour medicine for the patients, and said in disbelief, ..
.. “That’s … that’s …” He took out his own bottle, looked at it repeatedly, and then understood.
He was extremely angry and wanted to charge over and hit Xu Xian.
At this moment, several patients ran over and grabbed him, saying, ..
.. “I took your medicine, but my illness didn’t go away! You! Give me my money back!”
The people nearby heard this and also grabbed him, saying, ..
.. “Doctor Xu’s medicine is free. Why is your medicine so expensive? Hurry up and give me my money back!”
Even more people came running over, shouting for the traveling doctor to return their money.
More and more people came. They searched the traveling doctor and took all the money he had on him.
People were grabbing the traveling doctor, and there was nothing he could do. Soon, he didn’t even have a penny left on him.
The traveling doctor was extremely angry. He looked at Xu Xian in the pharmacy and wanted to go over and hit him.
A white bolt of lightning struck, sending the traveling doctor flying.
The traveling doctor fell into a forest. It really hurt!
He called out as he got up, and then saw a girl dressed in green.
He asked in surprise, “Who are you?”
The girl dressed in green asked, “Why did the people in the city get sick?”
He asked with even more surprise, “Who are you?”
“Not going to answer? Then I’m going to fight you.” The girl dressed in green jumped over and hit him.
The traveling doctor was no match for the girl dressed in green.  He was quickly transformed back into his true  form—a black sheep.
“Miss, stop hitting me! I’ll tell!”
The black sheep said, “I put something bad in the river in the city, so anyone who drinks the river water will get sick.”
“Where did you get that bottle?”
“I found it on a mountain.”
“Where is the mountain?”
“Nanhai.”
“You’re able to transform into human form. Where did you cultivate?”
“Nanhai.”
The girl in green nodded with satisfaction and said, “You can go now. Don’t let my older sister and me see you ever again!”
The black sheep got up and ran away very quickly.
Seven days later, all the sick people in the city recovered.
Bai Suzhen and Xu Xian also poured the medicine from the bottle into the river in the city. Now the river water had also become clean.
Everyone was very grateful to Xu Xian and Bai Suzhen, saying that they truly were the best doctors in the world.
Everyone really trusted them, and that feeling was truly wonderful.
Xiaoqing followed them and also felt that life in the human world was becoming more and more interesting.
